title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-jjhj: schc/fragment.rs from_bytes uses raw bytes but write_to uses 7+1 bit packing (round-trip broken)
description: Fragment::write_to encodes payload/MIC using 7+1 bit packing: each input byte is split into high-7-bits in output[N] and low-1-bit in output[N+1]. But Fragment::from_bytes reads data[2..] as raw bytes without un-packing them. This means a fragment.serialize() -> Fragment::from_bytes() round-trip produces mangled payload. The deleted dead code (lines 195-231) correctly did bit un-packing with `(data[wire] << 7) | (data[wire + 1] >> 1)` but also had wrong header bit positions. Fix needed: from_bytes must un-pack the 7+1 format, matching write_tos header layout (window at bit 6 per FRAGMENT_N=6, fcn at bits 0-5). Or: change write_to to use raw bytes (simpler but larger wire format).
